 Iowa fuel prices decrease by 25 cents since last week 
 Business Record Staff | Nov 18, 2026 | 4:19 pm | | 95 words | All Latest News , Energy , Registered | 
 Unleaded gasoline prices declined 25 cents from last week, averaging $3.57 across Iowa as of Nov. 18. The prices are 89 cents higher than this time last year. The national average fell 23 cents to $3.69. Diesel fuel prices in Iowa decreased by 29 cents this week, averaging $5.57. At this time last year, diesel averaged $3.69 statewide. The national average for diesel fuel is $5.96. Global crude oil decreased to $3.57 per barrel and is currently priced at $82.22. At this time last year, crude oil was priced at $61.51 per barrel.
